thinEntry.reason: node:fs.readFileSync/readDir/cp calls and static ESM imports do not consult an origin-map JSON automatically.
newReadOnlyVerifierDesign: Use a new non-frozen entry to read an origin map with the raw prefix move plus exact top-Markdown entries.
Preserve a pin's original logical file identity; resolve its physical input, then compare original bytes and SHA256.
A sidecar may record logical-to-physical resolution; never rewrite frozen manifests to new paths or current Gate wording.
If zero active compatibility files is required while launching old scripts, an explicitly used scoped filesystem+ESM resolver/preload is also needed; a plain data map cannot cover static import.

Such a resolver must cover absolute Windows/Linux workspace prefixes, file URLs, readFileSync/exists/stat/readdir/copy read sides and child-launch propagation as applicable. It has not been implemented or verified here.
thinEntry.portableDefault: Five exact regular input mirrors plus the new archive-aware read-only verification entry. This avoids changing frozen replay sources or duplicating48MB of evidence.
thinEntry.filesystemLinks: A directory link plus per-Markdown links is a different compatibility mechanism, not a thin JSON map or regular same-byte file set. Cross-platform Git/Windows link materialization, lstat and recursive-walk behavior would need a separately scoped decision and verification; not recommended as an unverified default.

historicalRecipeLimits.reason: G0/G1 producers read/write active formal packages and top lifecycle paths; publication has fixed initial-HEAD/Gate preconditions. They are historical recipes, not harmless G4 verification commands.

Read/verify old candidates and formal pins, walk evidence trees and create original outputs with wx/nonexistence assertions. Archive resolution of old inputs is needed for verification; rerunning writers after G4 would require separately chosen new outputs and must not regenerate originals.

The .gitattributes content is compared to an exact original suffix. Adding archive attributes is a metadata change not solved by path mapping; do not claim that original checker reexecution remains applicable unchanged.

Whole active-doc-tree cpSync calls require an archive-aware source plan if those old preparation commands are reused. The five-file set supports direct replay inputs, not reconstruction of the original whole active tree.

Original pre-G1 witness scripts also import the retained tmp/a-input and tmp/b-input builders. Those ignored originals remain an independent preservation dependency, not a reason to duplicate archived actual evidence into active docs.
